meta.title: Limited Community Reinvestment Agency Cra Meeting

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (setting the date of Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 1 p.m. to accept public comment and consider approving a resolution amending the CRA final budget for Fiscal Year 2025-26, Budget Amendment No. 3)
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which sets a public hearing date of May 12, 2026 to consider CRA Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2025-26, covering property tax increment adjustments, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, and other budgetary items including $1.6 million in interest revenue and a $2.3 million Library accounting adjustment.
